patient_sampling: sample source patients with replacement; duplicate all ICU rows by patient multiplicity; retain each patient's frozen repeat-1 fold
refit_rule: refit rich comparator and rich comparator + stripped Open-Jev in all five folds for every replicate
heldout_multiplicity: retain bootstrap multiplicity in held-out AUROC calculation
primary_interval: two-sided 95% percentile interval from the 500 refit-bootstrap delta-AUROC replicates
multiplicity: Holm adjustment across ventilation, RRT, and MetaVision ICU-death primary p-values at family-wise alpha 0.05
fold_partition_variance: not covered by the refit bootstrap; repeats 2-5 are separate split-stability analyses
runtime_benchmark_role: engineering feasibility only; benchmark results may motivate parallelization, checkpointing, or task partitioning but do not change B or the inferential estimand
runtime_contingency: if 500 replicates are operationally too slow, optimize execution and re-benchmark before registration; do not reduce B based on observed runtime alone
